question.text: Kautilya Cat III AIF has NAV = INR 500 crore. It holds Long Stock Futures notional = INR 400 crore, Short Stock Futures (same stock, same expiry) notional = INR 150 crore, and Long Index Futures notional = INR 250 crore. After permitted offsetting, compute the Leverage ratio. Does it breach the 2x cap?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (pages 402-403), Cat III leverage = total exposure / NAV with a maximum of 2x NAV, and long-short positions on the same underlying with the same maturity may be offset. Net stock exposure = 400 - 150 = INR 250 crore. Index futures stand separately (different underlying) at INR 250 crore. Total exposure = 250 + 250 = INR 500 crore. Leverage = 500 / 500 = 1.00x, well within the 2x cap. The Trap: 1.60x uses gross 400 + 250 without applying the same-stock, same-expiry offset. 0.80x double-offsets. 1.30x wrongly offsets index futures against stock futures, which is not permitted because the underlyings differ. Note: The leverage formula and 2x cap are on page 402; the same-underlying, same-maturity offsetting rule for futures and options exposures is on page 403.
